exposure: Magnesium sulfate alone vs. magnesium sulfate combined with nifedipine
outcome: Expression levels of suppressors of cytokine signaling-3 (SOCS-3)
finding: Magnesium sulfate combined with nifedipine showed a significantly better curative effect on pregnancy-induced hypertension, higher eutocia rate, lower cesarean section rate, and fewer adverse reactions compared to magnesium sulfate alone.
mod_finding: The study found that the eutocia rate was significantly higher in the study group compared to the control group, while the cesarean section rate was lower in the study group.
